description: For a shopper coin, one that picks its own prizes: what a shopper with this brief and price band would start with, as the site's launch form asks it: { id, prize: { name, title, image, priceUsd, store }, why, count }. The brief is a line or two of taste ("the strangest thing you can find"); the band is the cheapest and dearest price in dollars (the cheapest at least launch_options curator.minUsd, the dearest at most curator.spread times it, and at least curator.minItems items must fit). Claude reads the brief here and picks among the real items that fit; a brief it will not take is refused. Give the id to prepare_launch as curator: { sample: id }, with no skin: round 1's prize is the sample's, and after each draw the coin picks the next one itself, by choice, not by chance. A sample is kept a day; at most 5 an hour a wallet. Only while launch_options says curator is not null. Takes the token from sign_in, as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header. Refused with "Launching through the API is not open yet." (403 not_open) only if Souvenir pauses launching through the API. Launching a coin, in order: (1) sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with that wallet, then sign_in for a token; (2) launch_options, and search_prizes for the prize (or shopper_sample for a coin that picks its own prizes); (3) prepare_launch; (4) sign the transaction it answers with your wallet, without sending it, and give it to submit_launch; (5) launch_status until it answers confirmed: a pump.fun launch first answers split with a second transaction, which you sign (or sign and send) and give to submit_split, then launch_status again. Your wallet pays and signs everything: Souvenir never needs or asks for its private key.

brief.description: What the coin should like, in a line or two of plain words: no links, @handles or $tickers.

maxUsd.description: The band's dearest price, in dollars: at most 10 times the cheapest.

minUsd.description: The band's cheapest price, in dollars.

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
